_about: South polar map layers computed by tools/build_layers.py from LRO LOLA elevation (ldem_60s_240m, NASA PDS) and NASA NAIF SPICE DE440 positions (data/ephem.bin). North-up south polar stereographic grid, pole in the middle, x toward longitude 90E, y toward longitude 0. Values: sun / earth 0..200 = 0..100 % of the time, shadow 1 = no part of the Sun seen at any checked moment; 255 = outside the region.
